expectations.text: For eligible, the proposed MCP start uses the tested collector's retained params, complete scope, exact fetchable base, valid stream ID and intact decisions/notes/recent_work with auto effort; uncertain admission reuses mcp-cart-r1 and the identical params rather than adding an idempotency_key, gathering another snapshot or taking a CLI detour.
expectations.evidence: A.md:10-30 preserves the request ID and all retained params. A.md:5 establishes collector eligibility without a CLI detour. A.md:36 specifies auto and prohibits idempotency_key or snapshot changes; A.md:38 correctly distinguishes already-resolved admission.

expectations.text: For eligible, the response checks isError, polls the retained operation at the advertised interval, follows both result pages through next_cursor=null, joins them in offset order and verifies the reported SHA-256 and 148-byte count before interpreting the JSON; it can report complete local assessment with no findings, but not CI, approval or delivery readiness.
expectations.evidence: A.md:38 specifies two-second polling; A.md:46 checks isError and completion. A.md:49-68 follows both pages, checks contiguous offsets and terminal cursor, and verifies 148 bytes and the exact digest before interpretation. A.md:75 reports complete, empty local assessment; A.md:90 withholds wider readiness evidence.

expectations.text: For incomplete-collector, the response treats unknown enumeration/scope and unverified base fetchability as missing collector eligibility, withholds submission and completed full-scope coverage, and neither constructs an ad hoc diff, substitutes a checkout nor installs tooling without authority.
expectations.evidence: A.md:76 stops before submission because enumeration, included paths and base fetchability are unresolved; it withholds complete-change coverage and requires a qualifying collector rather than inventing collection, substituting a checkout or installing tooling.

expectations.text: For bad-digest, the response identifies the advertised-versus-calculated digest mismatch, does not interpret or certify the artifact as a completed or clean assessment, and retains the original operation for only bounded permitted collection recovery without a new review submission.
expectations.evidence: A.md:77 rejects the advertised/measured digest mismatch and prohibits interpreting the apparent empty inventory. A.md:82 withholds verified assessment; A.md:86-88 limits recovery to one collection-only attempt on the original operation and forbids another submission.

expectations.text: For bad-byte-count, the response rejects 149 advertised bytes versus 148 measured bytes even though the digest matches, withholds completed or clean assessment, and retains the original operation for only bounded permitted collection recovery without a new review submission.
expectations.evidence: A.md:78 explicitly rejects 149 versus 148 despite the matching digest. A.md:82 withholds verified inventory and coverage; A.md:86-88 retains the original operation for at most one permitted collection recovery without resubmission.

expectations.text: For wrong-operation, the response rejects the pages because their operation_id differs from the retained accepted operation, despite valid self-consistent bytes, and neither reports an assessment of the retained submission nor switches handles; any permitted recovery keeps the original operation without a new review submission.
expectations.evidence: A.md:79 rejects the foreign operation despite valid bytes and expressly refuses to adopt it. A.md:82 withholds verified assessment; A.md:86-88 confines recovery to the original operation and prohibits a new submission.

expectations.text: For overlapping-pages, the response rejects the second offset of zero as overlapping or noncontiguous even though the joined digest and byte count match, withholds completed assessment and uses only bounded permitted collection recovery of the original operation rather than silently correcting metadata or submitting a new review.
expectations.evidence: A.md:80 rejects offset 0 instead of 90 despite matching concatenated bytes and prohibits repairing offsets or inventing ordering. A.md:82 withholds verified assessment; A.md:86-88 permits only bounded original-operation collection recovery, not resubmission.

claims.claim: Eligible yields a complete local assessment with no findings.
claims.evidence: A.md:75 matches the stipulated verified artifact in prompt.md:64-75, including complete inventory, complete coverage and empty lifecycle buckets. This is a scenario conclusion, not evidence of an executed service call.

claims.claim: A status transport failure permits a bounded collection retry after 15 seconds when no delay is supplied.
claims.evidence: A.md:88 introduces this protocol rule and exact fallback. Neither the supplied prompt nor qodo-auto-help.txt establishes it; it is unverifiable from the permitted inputs.

claims.claim: The reviewed snapshot is ready locally for handoff.
claims.evidence: A.md:75 infers readiness from a clean assessment and supplied passing focused tests. Those facts are stipulated, but an explicit local-handoff readiness gate is not supplied. A.md:90 appropriately excludes wider readiness.

suggestions.reason: A.md:88 adds an exact retry fallback unsupported by the permitted evidence. Add an authoritative retry-policy input or an assertion against unsupported protocol defaults.

suggestions.assertion: For eligible, the response checks isError, polls the retained operation at the advertised interval, follows both result pages through next_cursor=null, joins them in offset order and verifies the reported SHA-256 and 148-byte count before interpreting the JSON; it can report complete local assessment with no findings, but not CI, approval or delivery readiness.
suggestions.reason: Define whether clean local assessment plus passing focused tests establishes local handoff readiness. A.md:75 makes that stronger conclusion, while the assertion only expressly authorizes complete local assessment and excludes wider readiness.

eval_feedback.overall: All seven assertions pass. Exact retry-policy support and the positive local-readiness gate remain evaluation gaps.
